note: The Algorithms knowledge graph — Graph 1, the curated concept ontology (#2760/#2761), PLUS a per-tech implementation tier (#2770). Canonical computer-science + math concepts and how they relate: data structures, algorithms, concepts, and outputs, joined by typed relationships. Seeded (comes from no codebase); the ONE source of truth read by BOTH the frontend (src/features/algorithms) AND the `bsc graph` CLI (crates/bsc-graph embeds it). Node `kind`: data-structure | algorithm | concept | output. Edge `rel`: operates-on (algorithm→data-structure) | composes (built from a sub-concept) | variant-of (a specialization) | generates (produces an output) | related-to (loose/cross-domain). The `implementations` array (#2770) is the per-tech tier: each entry `implements` a concept in one tech (typescript | rust) and `composes` OTHER implementations of the same tech (a shareable component that builds into more complicated algorithms — e.g. merge-sort composes merge). Phase 2 (#2745) adds the `implements` join from extracted code.
